title: You're not going to find better for this price
text: You're not going to find better for this price. All i wanted was a plan and sturdy table. I love puzzles and every table I ran into had a lip or designs, drawers, or extra bars for support (so I can't sit comfortable underneath it). This table is sturdy, it's stylish, and it's perfectly plain too. I assembled it alone in about 10 minutes. If you're hesitating, don't. It's definitely worth it.
